en: A vintage monochrome (green-tinted) postcard showing a brick railway station building with a gabled central section, chimneys, tall windows, and a metal roof. Two people stand on the path leading to the entrance. There are telegraph poles and some trees in the foreground. Printed text below the image reads "Klippan, Jernvägsstationen." and along the left edge appears the publisher information.
